picks.name: DJ Die
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on GutterFunk. Bristol drum & bass veteran, co-founder of Full Cycle Recordings.
picks.bio: "Rock Steady" (August 12, 2026, GutterFunk) is a single from Bristol drum & bass legend DJ Die -- co-founder of Full Cycle Recordings and a core member of Reprazent, whose New Forms won the 1997 Mercury Prize.
picks.why_listen: A heavyweight jungle/drum & bass cut from one of the genre's founding figures -- a solid peak-time tool from a deep catalogue worth digging into.
